"""Constants and public API for glom.

This module provides a central location for constants and is intended
to be the public interface for glom's internal components.
"""

# Backward compatibility alias - consts is deprecated, use constants instead
consts = None  # Will be set below when __init__.py imports


def __getattr__(name):
    """Provide backward compatibility for 'consts' attribute access."""
    if name == 'consts':
        import warnings
        warnings.warn(
            "glom.consts is deprecated, use glom.constants instead",
            DeprecationWarning,
            stacklevel=2
        )
        return constants
    raise AttributeError("module %r has no attribute %r" % (__name__, name))


# Import core items that should be in constants
from glom.core import (
    glom, register, Glommer, Call, Spec, OMIT, SKIP, STOP, Check,
    Path, Literal, Coalesce, Inspect, GlomError, CheckError,
    PathAccessError, CoalesceError, UnregisteredTarget, T, S
)
from glom.mutation import Assign, assign, PathAssignError
from glom.reduction import Sum, Fold, Flatten, flatten, FoldError, Merge, merge

# New specifier types
from glom.core import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT
from glom.core import Invoke

# All public API items are available as attributes of this module
__all__ = [
    # Core functions and classes
    'glom', 'register', 'Glommer',
    # Specifier types
    'Call', 'Spec', 'Check', 'Path', 'Literal', 'Coalesce', 'Inspect',
    'Assign', 'Sum', 'Fold', 'Flatten', 'Merge',
    # New specifiers
    'Auto', 'Fill', 'Iter', 'Let', 'ROOT', 'Invoke',
    # Functions
    'assign', 'flatten', 'merge',
    # Sentinels
    'OMIT', 'SKIP', 'STOP', 'T', 'S',
    # Constants
    'consts', 'constants',
    # Errors
    'GlomError', 'CheckError', 'PathAccessError', 'CoalesceError',
    'UnregisteredTarget', 'PathAssignError', 'FoldError',
]

# Make constants accessible via the module itself
constants = sys.modules[__name__] if '__name__' in dir() else None

import sys
constants = sys.modules[__name__]
